# PR Template

## Description

[Provide a clear and concise description of the changes introduced by this PR. Explain the "why" behind the changes, not just the "what".]

## Type of Change

Please check the option that applies to your PR:

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Code Refactor / Chore (code changes that do not fix a bug or add a feature)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Related Issue

[If this PR fixes an open issue, please link it here. E.g., "Resolves #123"]

- Resolves #

## Checklist

Before requesting a review, please confirm that you have completed the following steps:

- [ ] I have read the **Contribution Guidelines** in the `README.md`.
- [ ] My PR targets the `develop` branch (NOT `main`).
- [ ] My branch follows the naming convention (e.g., `feat/...`, `fix/...`, `chore/...`).
- [ ] I have used **conventional commit messages** (e.g., `feat: added target subtopic validator`).
- [ ] I have installed and run `pre-commit` locally, and all checks passed.
- [ ] I have run the tests (`pytest`) and they all pass successfully.
- [ ] I have added or updated tests for my new code (if applicable).
- [ ] My code does not produce any new warnings.

## Additional Information / Screenshots

[Add any extra context, logs, or screenshots here. If your PR includes changes to the AI Engine or Tavily search responses, providing sample outputs here is highly recommended.]
